decisions.statement: The same gathering of a resource's values serves the yaml and the handing over.
The yaml is said rather than applied.
A resource has the keys every page placing a value in it names.
The keys are said in one order.
A resource unchanged says the same bytes.
A resource no page places a value in is refused rather than said empty.
A resource's type is said as given.
A resource given no type is said as Opaque.
The type a Secret is on the cluster cannot be changed once that Secret is there.
A resource's labels are said as given.
A resource given no label says no labels key at all.
A label's name runs up to the first `=`.
A label's value runs from the first `=` on.
An entry with no `=` is refused rather than passed over.
Two pages placing a value in one resource at one key are refused here too.

definition: the values one resource's pages hold, said as yaml or handed over key by key
